== Notes ==
* The initial holy damage dealt by this skill is [[armor-ignoring damage]]; the holy damage dealt by attacks is armor-respecting.
* Heroes will maintain this enchantment out of combat. They will also attempt to move into range of enemies to deal damage with it, which may be undesirable for ranged attacking heroes.

== Trivia==
* This spell uses the [[Wind Prayers]] casting animation.
* The face in the background of the [[skill icon]] appears to be [[Balthazar]]'s.
